properties.description: Unorthodox (2020) is a four-episode dramatic miniseries directed by Maria Schrader and adapted from Deborah Feldman’s memoir. Tonally restrained yet emotionally potent, the show combines social realism with intimate psychological focus, offering a culturally specific, emotionally resonant portrait of self-discovery.

The narrative traces the slow, often painful process of disentangling identity, tradition, and belonging as she learns to make choices for herself.

The narrative alternates between clever, cinematic heists and quieter, character-driven moments—exploring identity, race, class, and the moral ambiguity of taking the law into one’s own hands—until a high-stakes cat-and-mouse between Avenger and establishment culminates in public reckonings and personal risk.
